verdict.rationale: Swell documents CSV import and export for products, including categories (swell-docs-14). A backend REST API with basic-auth secret keys and official Node/PHP libraries offers programmatic JSON access (swell-docs-7, swell-docs-39). A single call returns the store's full schema across standard, custom and app-installed models (swell-docs-9), so a user could script a full extraction. That falls well short of a documented 'export everything and leave' path, and the probes found no published OpenAPI spec (swell-probe-2). Missing for 10: documented bulk export of all data types (orders, customers, subscriptions, custom models), documented open-format full-store export or migration tooling, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a complete data exit.
